entry.title: The BMW M Edition 100 Jahre Nürburgring.

media:group.media:title: The BMW M Edition 100 Jahre Nürburgring.
media:group.media:description:
To mark the 100th anniversary of the Nürburgring, BMW M presenting an anniversary edition ‘100 Jahre Nürburgring’. More information: https://www.bmw-m.com/en/all-models/overview-m-and-m-performance/edition-100-jahre-nurburgring.html This edition comprises six BMW M high-performance automobiles paying tribute to a motoring institution that exemplifies driving dynamics, precision, and performance.
The edition includes the BMW M2, BMW M3 Sedan, BMW M3 Touring, BMW M4 Coupé, BMW M5 Sedan and BMW M5 Touring. Each model is available in two paint options: the specially developed Nürburgring Green created for the anniversary edition and Sapphire Black metallic. Both colour options are complemented by Nordschleife inspired design elements and edition specific details that reinforce the direct link to the so-called ‘Green Hell’. These aesthetic features are combined with carefully selected equipment and interior elements to create an exclusive appearance that reflects both the vehicles’ racetrack provenance, as well as their everyday usability.

entry.title: United by Performance - The Best of Tutto Bene Hillclimb 2026.

media:group.media:title: United by Performance - The Best of Tutto Bene Hillclimb 2026.
media:group.media:description:
The best of global car culture, with an unmistakable Italian flair. From the shores of Lago Maggiore to the winding roads of the hillclimb, the 3rd annual Tutto Bene brought together a curated community of drivers, collectors, designers and creatives united by a shared passion for performance and driving culture. Every detail, every car and every conversation felt like a new discovery. Thanks to Race Service and Borromeo de Silva, the event became more than a gathering of enthusiasts. It became a place where friendships were strengthened, stories were created and memories were made.
For GEN M, Tutto Bene is not just about documenting an event. It's about celebrating the people, passion and culture that move our community forward.

entry.title: On the Way to Tutto Bene. Behind the wheel with The Kyza.

media:group.media:title: On the Way to Tutto Bene. Behind the wheel with The Kyza.
media:group.media:description:
On the journey from Munich to Lago Maggiore, Khyzyl takes us along for the ride. Produced in the creator's own visual language, the film captures personal thoughts, group dynamics and spontaneous moments along the way. Unfolding naturally through the drive, it documents the shared journey of four GEN M members on their way to Tutto Bene.
More than a roadtrip, it's a story about friendship, creativity and a shared passion for driving culture. Because sometimes the best moments happen long before reaching the destination.
